details: Senate Republicans have released an updated version of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act), which now includes new ethics provisions. The Trump administration is actively pushing for the bill's passage, highlighting its potential to bring regulatory certainty to the cryptocurrency industry. However, the updated text faces scrutiny from some lawmakers and law enforcement groups who express concerns about the ethics provisions and the potential for the act to be exploited by criminal elements.
title: US Senate Progresses on CLARITY Act Amid Ethics Concerns

details: US Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded a significant net inflow of $233.1 million, with BlackRock's IBIT leading the way with $183.4 million in new investments. Similarly, US Spot Ethereum ETFs experienced positive net inflows totaling $12.8 million, primarily driven by BlackRock's ETHA. These inflows indicate a renewed and growing institutional interest in both Bitcoin and Ethereum, despite a generally cautious market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Spot ETFs See Positive Inflows

details: Pi Network (PI) saw a notable 4.8% increase in its token price following the announcement of its upcoming Protocol 26 upgrade, scheduled for August 11. Concurrently, Binance Coin (BNB) also experienced significant gains. This surge came after Binance disclosed its intention to seek approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to launch a new predictions market platform, positioning itself to compete with established players in the sector.
title: Pi Coin and BNB Outperform with Key Developments

details: Coinbase announced a 19% year-over-year decrease in its Q2 2026 revenue, totaling $1.22 billion, primarily attributed to a downturn in trading revenue. Meanwhile, MicroStrategy, which held approximately 843,775 Bitcoin by July 26, reported substantial valuation losses on its Bitcoin holdings in its Q2 earnings statement.
title: Coinbase Reports 19% Revenue Decline, MicroStrategy Posts Bitcoin Valuation Losses

details: Uniswap has successfully activated its protocol fee switch on v4 liquidity pools across seven different blockchain networks. This implementation is already generating approximately $325,000 in daily revenue for the protocol and is contributing to the burning of UNI tokens. This development is largely seen as a positive step for Uniswap's long-term sustainability and is expected to bolster the value of its native token.
title: Uniswap Activates Fee Switch on v4 Pools, Generates Daily Revenue
